mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) over the past two months indicates inflationary pressures, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL increases by > 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE decreases by > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the past two months indicates a strengthening demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where HOUST increases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over the past month signals a weakening supply side of the economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO decreases by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the past month indicates a robust consumer-driven economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it signals a monetary tightening cycle with a slowing economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 2% and GDPC1 growth rate < 0%.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the past month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a robust labor market, which is a strong indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months indicates a strong economic demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 50% of instances where GDPC1 increases.
